segments.source: Problem 506. The best route from Stone to Cedar
segments.translation: Problema 506. Cel mai bun traseu de la Stone la Cedar

segments.source: A road map can be modeled as a graph. The best route depends on the stated criterion, not on how short it looks on paper.
segments.translation: O hartă rutieră poate fi modelată ca un graf. Cel mai bun traseu depinde de criteriul enunțat, nu de cât de scurt pare pe hârtie.

segments.source: Stone–Dover–Cedar has segment costs [5, 6] (total 11); Stone–Oak–Meadow–Cedar has segment costs [4, 2, 5] (total 11); Stone–Linden–Cedar has segment costs [8, 3] (total 11).
segments.translation: Stone–Dover–Cedar are costurile pe segmente [5, 6] (total 11); Stone–Oak–Meadow–Cedar are costurile pe segmente [4, 2, 5] (total 11); Stone–Linden–Cedar are costurile pe segmente [8, 3] (total 11).

segments.source: A route is feasible only if all of its roads are open. The cost of a route is the sum of its segment costs. Choose the feasible route with the smallest total.
segments.translation: Un traseu este realizabil doar dacă toate drumurile lui sunt deschise. Costul unui traseu este suma costurilor segmentelor sale. Alegem traseul realizabil cu cel mai mic total.

segments.source: Which route should a traveler use from Stone to Cedar, and why?
segments.translation: Ce traseu ar trebui să folosească un călător de la Stone la Cedar și de ce?

segments.source: 1. List the candidate routes and their segment costs. 2. All listed routes are open. 3. Add the segment costs for every feasible route. 4. The smallest feasible total is 11, on Stone–Dover–Cedar.
segments.translation: 1. Enumerăm traseele posibile și costurile segmentelor lor. 2. Toate traseele enumerate sunt deschise. 3. Adunăm costurile segmentelor pentru fiecare traseu realizabil. 4. Cel mai mic total realizabil este 11, pe Stone–Dover–Cedar.

segments.source: A shortest path is a reasoning result: first respect constraints, then compare the remaining costs.
segments.translation: Drumul cel mai scurt este rezultatul unui raționament: mai întâi respectăm constrângerile, apoi comparăm costurile rămase.

segments.source: Weighted graph; delete forbidden edges; minimize the sum of edge weights.
segments.translation: Graf ponderat; eliminăm muchiile interzise; minimizăm suma ponderilor muchiilor.
